Amit — thanks for the SOW and W-9. We're happy to get the pilot moving quickly. A few notes on how we typically handle short pilots without a formal PO:  

- Standard temporary path: 90-day invoice-only pilot (Finance issues invoices net-30).
- Controls required for approval: low-risk evidence (company registration, W-9, & basic SOC2 self-attestation accepted for short pilots).
- Thresholds: we can approve invoice-only up to $12k/month spend; above that we require a PO or advance approval from Procurement.
- Operational safeguards: billing contact, project owner, usage alerts (we'll configure token threshold alerts).

To move forward please:  
1) Confirm AP contact and billing address (we have the W-9 but need invoice routing).
2) Provide any procurement contact who needs the waiver rationale (so we can loop them into the DocuSign addendum if required).
3) Sign the short waiver addendum (1 page) that limits exposure and confirms the pilot scope.

Marissa, Naomi — looping you both for procurement + finance sign-off and the addendum draft. If you need any additional docs from Cartline, flag them here and we'll request.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwoodinference.com | +1 628-555-0123

Thanks, Sean and Amit. I've drafted a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a one-page waiver addendum to cover the pilot period. Key points:  

- Term: 90 days starting on the first invoice.
- Billing: invoice-only, net-30 to Cartline AP (invoice to: accounts.payable@cartline.io).
- Spend cap: $12,000/month for the pilot; usage alerts at 75% and 100% of monthly cap.
- Evidence required: signed SOW (received), W-9 (received), company website + primary contact (Amit).
- Conversion: If monthly invoice > $12k or Cartline requests capacity guaranteed, we'll require a PO and work with Procurement to finalize terms.

Attachments: MAP-draft.docx (redline welcome), waiver-addendum.pdf (DocuSign link below).
